canonical_project: Naver second data center Eumseong / Chungbuk Innovation City candidate site
owner: Naver; Chungcheongbuk-do and Eumseong-gun as site promoters
notes: Eumseong/Chungbuk Innovation City was one of ten shortlisted locations visited for Naver's second data center in 2019, with reports describing a KRW 540 billion project. Naver ultimately built and opened GAK Sejong, so this candidate is treated as rejected/not selected rather than an active Eumseong project.
